artifact.name: go-cask object browser
artifact.purpose: Browse a content-addressed object store, inspect one selected object, and filter or page the object index.
principles: Use a compact operational interface, not a dashboard or marketing page.
Prioritize hashes, types, sizes, reference counts, and written time.
Keep the object table and detail inspector visible together on desktop.
Use a flat visual system with hairline dividers rather than card-heavy surfaces.
Do not show object property values when there is no selected object.

overflow.objectTable: scroll vertically and horizontally as needed

mobile.inspector: below object list with top hairline divider

emptyState.message: No objects match the current filters.

regions.left: range and total, e.g. 1-25 of 512 objects

buttonState.hover: background becomes page background and border becomes foreground

regions.border: left hairline divider on desktop; top hairline divider on mobile

regions.emptyState: Keep the label but show no hash when no object is selected.

regions.layout: horizontal row with 2px gap and 6px 8px 0 padding
regions.interaction: Exactly one tab panel is visible. Tab controls are buttons, not navigation links.

regions.propertyLayout: two columns: 96px label column and flexible value column
regions.emptyState: Render section labels and property labels only. All property values must be blank.

row.layout: direction arrow, type badge, shortened hash

regions.emptyState: Both reference lists are empty when there is no selected object.

regions.content: First 128 bytes of the selected object, formatted as 8 rows of offset, 16 hex bytes, and ASCII.
regions.emptyState: Empty when there is no selected object.

object.hash: string; full content address including algorithm prefix, e.g. sha256:<64 hex characters>
object.type: string; envelope type such as bytes@1, json@1, or text@1
object.size: integer byte count or formatted display value

derived.shortHash: algorithm prefix plus a shortened digest ending in an ellipsis
derived.bytePreview: derived from object bytes; show no more than 128 bytes
derived.referencesIn: zero or more object references pointing to the selected object
derived.referencesOut: zero or more object references made by the selected object

rules: Changing page size resets page to 1.
Selecting a row updates the inspector and selected-row state.
A filter with zero results clears selection and all inspector values.
Pager boundaries disable unavailable page controls.
Rows are paged; do not render an unbounded result set into the DOM.

interactions.result: Filter by hash prefix or type text and reset pagination.
Filter objects by selected envelope type and reset pagination.
Filter by configured size bucket and reset pagination.
Clear all filters, restore default page size, and return to page 1.
Select the object and refresh all three inspector panels from that object.

interactions.trigger: Metadata, References, or Bytes tab button
interactions.result: Set that tab active and show only its associated content panel.
Update page size, recompute total pages, and return to page 1.
Move to the appropriate valid page and update disabled states.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements have a visible 2px accent focus outline with 2px offset.
accessibility.table: Expose column headers and selection state. Rows must be keyboard-selectable in production.
accessibility.tabs: Use button controls with tab semantics, selected state, and corresponding tab panels.
accessibility.controls: Each select and input has an accessible label.
accessibility.color: Do not use color as the only selected-state indicator; retain the leading inset line and active tab border.

frameworkAgnostic: Keep one normalized object collection and derive filtered, sorted, paged rows from it.
Keep selection separate from the visible page so a selected object can remain addressable.
Render only the current page of rows for performance.
Treat the inspector as a projection of the selected object, not duplicated state.
Use actual object bytes for the hex view in production rather than deriving bytes from a hash.
serverRendered: Persist search, filters, page, page size, selected hash, and active tab in URL query parameters.
Swap the table and pager together as one result unit.
Return the full page for direct navigation and a fragment for partial-request navigation.
Use a separate inspector fragment keyed by selected hash.
